title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Choice

scenes.summary: Betal begins a story while Vikram carries him.
scenes.text: As King Vikram carried Betal through the forest, Betal began telling a story about a boy who found a purse of gold.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in dark forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The rich man accuses the boy.
scenes.text: The boy returned the purse, but the rich man accused him of stealing some coins.
scenes.image_prompt: rich man accusing honest boy while holding purse cartoon

scenes.summary: The case is taken to the king.
scenes.text: The matter was brought to the king, who carefully listened to both sides.
scenes.image_prompt: king listening to boy and rich man in court cartoon

scenes.summary: The king makes a clever judgment.
scenes.text: The king declared that the purse did not belong to the rich man because his story did not match.
scenes.image_prompt: king making judgment while people look surprised cartoon

scenes.summary: Betal asks a question and Vikram answers.
scenes.text: Betal asked Vikram who was right. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew back to the tree.
scenes.image_prompt: betal flying back to tree while vikram looks determined cartoon

story: While carrying Betal, Vikram heard a story about an honest boy who returned a purse. A greedy man falsely accused him, but a wise king judged fairly and rewarded honesty. Vikram answered Betal’s question correctly, and Betal flew away.
